header.title: Create. Compound. Claim.

header.title: The verified infrastructure that your capital deserves
header.subtitle: Thaler assigns every depositor their own vault, fully separated from all others. The strategy runs within boundaries each user approves at creation. Yield is delivered through a verified process. All under one protocol.

section.title: Your vault and how it operates

accounts.label: Vault Architecture
accounts.description: Each vault is an independent Squads Smart Account on Solana, owned entirely by your wallet. The operations are enforced by Squads Policy Network extensions when you create it and verified on-chain.

payments.label: Strategy Management
payments.description: Your positions across staking, lending, and perpetual markets are managed by a dedicated Cloudflare worker assigned exclusively to you, running independently and continuously without interruption.

stablecoin.label: Yield Settlement
stablecoin.description: Every yield claim settles completely or not at all. There are no partial or incomplete transactions. What you claim is exactly what arrives in your wallet.

header.title: Your strategy controls
header.subtitle: Select your risk mode configuration at vault creation, claim yield on your schedule, and monitor every position in real time.

cards.label: Risk Modes
cards.description:
Choose from Conservative to Aggressive at vault creation.
Each mode determines how the strategy allocates your capital and manages risk.
Manage capital diversification by deploying multiple vaults with independent risk modes.

billpay.label: Yield Claims
billpay.description:
Claim yield manually whenever it suits you.
Or set automatic claims on a weekly or monthly schedule.
Every claim settles to your wallet in full or not at all.

accounting.label: Position Monitoring
accounting.description:
Track principal, yield, and strategy composition in real time.
Clear capital allocation breakdown across all your vaults.
Export your transaction history for tax purposes and record-keeping.

header.title: How your yield is generated
header.subtitle: Earn regardless of market conditions across the best available venues with full returns transparency

earn.label: Structural Floor
earn.description:
The strategy produces a yield floor near 7% from its most stable components.
Staking rewards and liquidity provision generate a baseline return.
This floor holds even when the broader market declines.

holdings.label: Venue Selection
holdings.description:
Your dedicated Cloudflare worker selects the most efficient market for each part of the strategy.
Venue selection is set once, at vault creation, based on the risk mode you choose.
Once your configuration is fixed, no changes are made after deployment.

fx.label: Yield Composition
fx.description:
The strategy generates returns from three sources working as one.
Staking produces a steady baseline. Lending generates a carry trade income.
Perpetual position captures funding rates or downside price movement.

earn.label: Floor yield
earn.subtitle: Structural floor across all risk modes and market conditions

transparent.body: Every Thaler-One Vault action is publicly verifiable on-chain, in real time.

nonCustodial.title: Non-custodial by rule
nonCustodial.body: Your vault, your rules. No permissions needed and no middleman involved.

execution.title: Automated execution
execution.body: Your vault is managed by a dedicated Thaler worker, powered by Cloudflare, that runs the strategy you selected, around the clock.

deposit.label: Create a vault and deposit your capital.
deposit.description: Choose the mode that fits you best. Sign to deposit, start earning.

activate.label: Claim yield whenever suits you.
activate.description: Set it automatically or do it yourself. Weekly, monthly or whenever you need it.

receive.yieldNote: Yield starts accumulating the same block your Vault is created.

securityCard.title: Built without admin keys.
securityCard.body: Every Vault is an independent on-chain account. No admin key. No manual overrides. The protocol operates exactly as the code specifies, nothing more.

custodyCard.title: No counterparty. By design.
custodyCard.body: Your collateral is held in independent smart contracts, secured by Solana's validator network. No entity, including Thaler Finance, can redirect or freeze your position.

footer.disclaimer1: 1. Thaler Finance is a non-custodial protocol on Solana executing a predefined, non-discretionary yield strategy through independent third-party venues. User funds remain self-custodied at all times. Displayed APR and APY reflect the strategy's mechanics and prevailing third-party venue yields. See Protocol Terms and Risk Disclosures.
footer.disclaimer2: 2. Each vault is an independent Squads Smart Account owned by the user's wallet, with policies enforced on-chain by the Squads Policy Network (operated by Selimor Investments Limited). Vault operations are executed by Privy Agentic Wallets and Cloudflare Workers under the user's pre-authorized on-chain policy.
footer.disclaimer3: 3. Yield is generated on-chain by the strategy and accrues to your vault. When you claim, it settles directly to your wallet in SOL, in full or not at all, with no partial transfers. Displayed APR and APY are estimates based on strategy mechanics and prevailing third-party venue rates, not guarantees.
footer.disclaimer4: 4. Wallet provisioning and transaction signing use Privy embedded wallets and Privy Agentic Wallets, operated by Privy, Inc. Embedded wallets are self-custodial with signing authority retained by the user; Agentic Wallets operate under user-authorized policies scoped to strategy operations and revocable at any time.
footer.disclaimer5: 5. Strategy transaction bundles are constructed off-chain in Cloudflare isolated Workers' ephemeral, sandboxed environments that do not persist user keys. Bundles are submitted to Privy Agentic Wallets for signing strictly within the scope of the on-chain policy set at vault creation; Thaler holds no signing authority.
